scopes.name: identity:read
scopes.description: Read the calling client's own identity and effective scopes, and the portal's readiness. In a signed-in user's token, it lets the application ask for that user's current access.

scopes.name: notifications:write
scopes.description: Queue email notifications to individual recipients on behalf of the application, within its quota.

scopes.name: notifications:read
scopes.description: Read the delivery status of notifications the application sent.
